name: Is popcorn ceiling removal a messy job?

mainEntity.name: Is popcorn ceiling removal a messy job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, popcorn ceiling removal can be quite messy. The process involves scraping wet material off the ceiling, which often results in debris falling onto surfaces below. Professional contractors take extensive measures to minimize mess by covering all furniture, floors, and walls with plastic sheeting and tarps. They also use specialized equipment for dust control and thorough cleanup after the work is complete to protect your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, popcorn ceiling removal is messy due to falling debris, but professionals use extensive protective coverings and cleanup methods to minimize impact.
